notice.en: Tom didn't notice that Mary had a new hairstyle.
notice.zh: 汤姆没注意到玛莉换了新发型。

nightmare.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
nightmare.zh: 我觉得我好像从恶梦中惊醒。

nature.en: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.
nature.zh: 她通过一首诗表达了她对大自然的感受。

neck.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
neck.zh: 他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

nervous.en: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.
nervous.zh: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。

nonsense.en: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
nonsense.zh: 那是无稽之谈。只有傻瓜才会相信。

notebook.en: Tom wrote down something in his notebook.
notebook.zh: 汤姆在他的笔记本上写了东西。

navy.en: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
navy.zh: 玛丽穿着深蓝色的裙子。

novel.en: This is by far the best novel that has been published this year.
novel.zh: 这显然是今年出版的最好的小说。

noisy.en: Japan is an extremely noisy country.
noisy.zh: 日本是一个非常嘈杂的国家。

native.en: This book is for students whose native language is not Japanese.
native.zh: 这本书是给母语不是日语的学生的。

nap.en: Maybe I'll just give up soon and take a nap instead.
nap.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

nowhere.en: Tom had nowhere to return to.

nail.en: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
nail.zh: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

natural.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
natural.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。

needle.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
needle.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。

nearby.en: My wife buys vegetables from a supermarket nearby.
nearby.zh: 我老婆在附近的超市买蔬菜。

nowadays.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
nowadays.zh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

neighborhood.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
neighborhood.zh: 上周的暴风雨损坏了我们社区的许多树木。

napkin.en: May I have a napkin, please?
napkin.zh: 请给我一张餐巾纸好吗？

numerous.en: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
numerous.zh: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。

naive.en: I'm surprised that you're so naive.
naive.zh: 我很惊讶你竟然那么天真。

nephew.en: My nephew is allergic to eggs.

nerve.en: She had the nerve to speak out.

narrow.en: The gate is so narrow that the car can't pass through it.
narrow.zh: 门太窄了，这辆车通不过。

necklace.en: My grandma gave me this necklace.
necklace.zh: 这条项链是我奶奶送给我的。

neutral.zh: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。

necessarily.en: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.

nursery.zh: 你最喜欢的儿童歌曲是哪首？

normally.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
normally.zh: 句子通常有主词和动词。

necessity.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
necessity.zh: 电脑现在是一个绝对必要的东西了。

nation.en: Every nation, rich or poor, has its strengths and weaknesses.
nation.zh: 每个国家，无论贫富，都有其长，都有其短。

national.en: He's a professor at the National University.
national.zh: 他是国立大学的一名教授。

northern.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.

noun.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
noun.zh: 在这种情况下，形容词放在名词前面。

nasty.en: She gives me a nasty look every time she sees me.
nasty.zh: 她每次看见我都给露出厌恶的眼神。

noticeable.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.
noticeable.zh: 两者之间有显著的差别。

northwest.en: They marched northwest into the Shenandoah Valley.
northwest.zh: 他们向西北方向进军，进入了谢南多厄河谷。

nuclear.en: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
nuclear.zh: 我们所有的人都想除掉核子武器。

needless.en: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
needless.zh: 无须多言，基本人权应当被尊重。
